class.name: FSScriptDescriptor
class.brief_description: Parser-level metadata for a single FoundryScript file.
class.description: A read-only snapshot of a script's indexed metadata, produced by [FSProjectScripts] without loading or executing the file. Fields are populated from parser-level data at interface-resolved status; [method load_script] performs a full load only when a runner is ready to instantiate a suite. When [member indexed_ok] is [code]false[/code], indexing failed and [method get_index_diagnostics] returns non-empty error dictionaries (with [code]message[/code], [code]line[/code], and [code]column[/code] keys). Discovery itself does not print those diagnostics to the console. Class, method, and parameter annotations are exposed through the same [FSAnnotation] and [FSMethodDescriptor] types used by [FSReflection].

members.member: The native base or base script class name declared by the script.
The namespace-qualified fully qualified class name when the script declares a namespace.
The [code]class_name[/code] identity when declared; empty otherwise.
[code]false[/code] when parsing or indexing failed. Runners should treat the file as broken rather than silently skipping it.
[code]true[/code] when the script is a trait declaration.
The script resource path, for example [code]res://tests/inventory_tests.fs[/code].

method.name: get_class_annotations
method.description: Returns passive class annotations declared on the script. Empty when [member indexed_ok] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: get_index_diagnostics
method.description: Indexing errors and warnings for the script. Each dictionary contains [code]message[/code], [code]line[/code], and [code]column[/code]. Empty when [member indexed_ok] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: get_methods
method.description: Returns method descriptors for functions declared in the script, including method and parameter annotations. Empty when [member indexed_ok] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: implements_trait
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the indexed script implements the given trait. Accepts the fully qualified trait identity; short-name matching follows the same rules as [method FSReflection.implements_trait], including traits inherited from a base script.

method.name: load_script
method.description: Performs a full script load equivalent to [code]load(path)[/code]. Returns a null [code]Ref[/code] on failure. Descriptor metadata is not recomputed by this call.
